# Alegra API Documentation Documentation

## Guides
- [Información General](https://developer.alegra.com/docs/información-general.md): Esta página te ayudará a comenzar con el API de Alegra
- [Contactos](https://developer.alegra.com/docs/contactos.md)

## API Reference
- [Crear centro de costo](https://developer.alegra.com/reference/accounting__createcostcenter.md)
- [Listar asientos contables](https://developer.alegra.com/reference/accounting__listjournals.md)
- [Listar facturas de compra](https://developer.alegra.com/reference/expenses_list-bills.md): Herramienta MCP: `expenses_list-bills`.
- [Consultar flujo de caja](https://developer.alegra.com/reference/reports_get_cash_flow.md): Herramienta MCP: `reports_get_cash_flow`.
- [Listar productos](https://developer.alegra.com/reference/items_getitems.md): Herramienta MCP: `items_getItems`.
- [Listar facturas de proveedor](https://developer.alegra.com/reference/get_bills.md)
- [Listar impuestos](https://developer.alegra.com/reference/get_taxes.md)
- [Consultar impuesto](https://developer.alegra.com/reference/get_taxes-id.md)
- [Editar impuesto](https://developer.alegra.com/reference/put_taxes-id.md)
- [Eliminar impuesto](https://developer.alegra.com/reference/delete_taxes-id.md)
- [Crear suscripción a webhook](https://developer.alegra.com/reference/post_webhooks-subscriptions.md)
- [Listar conciliaciones](https://developer.alegra.com/reference/listreconciliations.md)
- [Crear cargo adicional](https://developer.alegra.com/reference/createAdditionalCharge.md)
- [Consultar impuesto (duplicado)](https://developer.alegra.com/reference/get_taxes-id.md)
